canva.placementReference: media starts below white headline area and extends behind date/logo overlays to the bottom boundary

redHighlightShape.fitRule: cover the complete first-line text with small, even side padding and remain horizontally centered

headlineColors.rule: all text overlapping the red highlight must be white

confirmed: A short theatre-fight clip was attached to the supplied X post
News18 reported the clip had gone viral
notConfirmed: That a murder or death occurred
Whether a formal complaint was filed
The authenticity of the claims attached to the clip

headlineGenerationMethod.outputRule: Exactly three lines, four to five easy words per line, with all lines together explaining the full incident.

captionDraft:
A short video showing a scuffle inside a cinema has gone viral alongside claims that an argument began over alleged spoilers during a Spider-Man screening. The precise location, circumstances and cause of the confrontation have not been officially confirmed.

No reliable report or official authority has confirmed the viral claim that a death occurred. News18 reported that the authenticity of the claims accompanying the clip remains unverified and that there was no official confirmation regarding the exact circumstances or any formal complaint.

Credit: @0xMiraqle on X. Verification reference: News18. Visual: source clip retained as an unverified viral video; a generated illustrative image is also available for contextual use. Claims are based on publicly available reports at posting time and remain subject to correction.
lesson: A single X post may contain multiple videos. Identify media by duration and media ID, exclude quoted long-form content, and preserve uncertainty when the attached narrative is not independently verified. Never ungroup or move the Canva date badge to edit its text; preserve the grouped layout and stop if the text cannot be safely edited in place.
